rationale: Ranking scope is denied_claims so code shares sum to one over denied claims as the task requires; quantify_missing=by_status covers all three missingness asks (overall, among denied, distribution across claim_status). Manifest shows denial_code_carc null in 11559 of 12845 rows and denial_reason_desc fully null, so the CARC code is the only usable code field and a missing-code bucket is essential. Denial rates use adjudicated_claims as the denominator (only claims whose adjudication has concluded), cover all five requested segments, and flag groups under 30 claims as unstable per the task and the categorical-comparison skill. The report prints numerator/denominator for every rate, cites artifacts for traceability, and carries the mandated synthetic-data and small-group caveats plus descriptive-only and association-not-causation wording since segment comparisons are cross-tabulations, not causal estimates. No joins are needed (single table, claim_id unique), so the join skill was not used.
